title: Reign of Ahasuerus (Xerxes I)
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). Dated only by the Generations books cited below; no tier 1–4 chronology covers this event.

sorting_basis.note: PROVISIONAL: no CFAH, Ussher–Jones or Ussher date exists, so the sort uses Generations (Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), PDF p. 541): 496–475 BC. Pending owner decision (open question A8).

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference (the CFAH series does not cover this period; no tier 1–4 date exists)

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 12 "The Kingdom of the Medes and Persians (725–330 BC)", PDF p. 378 (printed p. 377)
chronologies.note: Heading; Xerxes was murdered in 465 BC (p. 382).
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "496–475 BC" (PDF p. 541): 10 years earlier (ranges overlap).
